corrections.what: Drew the bulb symmetric about x 40.9: a true circle (r 23.34, centre y 55.88) for the glass, then mirrored cubic tapers that turn vertical at the neck (x 30.75 and 51.05)
corrections.why: DR-03 circles and symmetry. The glass's circle fit has rms 0.06 px; the taper fit (both sides mirrored onto one) has rms 0.14 px. Rays, filament and base share the axis, which moves the top ray and filament stem 0.25 px.

corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. They measure 45.1 and 135.1 degrees; ends differ by up to 0.3 px between sides.

corrections.why: DR-03 symmetry. Measured axes differ by part: cables 114.43, mast 114.2, piers 113.79, ends 114.0. The kinks fit 15.97 and 15.65 px out while the hangers stand 14.93 and 15.05 px out, so both now meet at 15.4. Cable edges move up to 0.5 px and the hangers up to 0.5 px.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. The icon measures 5.25 px.

notes: Kept: three separate subjects; the bulb's three rays; the filament T; the base box and slotted cap in black; the bridge's single mast, two hangers, two piers, deck and flattened cable ends past the piers; the ledger's open frame (right side stops at y 72.7, bottom line stops short of the right side); four rules; the dollar. Red follows the red sheet: glass, rays and filament are red, and red stops at the base's top edge (y 89.2), so the accent group is drawn first and the black base covers the feet of the red strokes. Black and red sheets agree.
